Faithfully flat descent of invertible modules, landed as pure algebra (Wave-3 lane L5, the honest algebraic core of Picard separatedness (C1) and rigidified effectivity (C2)): descent data in Sweedler-coring/comodule form (coaction M -> B tensor_A M with counit + coassociativity; dictionary to the classical B tensor B cocycle iso recorded), the descended A-module as the coaction equalizer, and the comparison B tensor_A M_0 -> M an isomorphism — effectivity needs only FLATNESS of A -> B (counit + coassoc make the augmented complex contractible after base change; a strengthening over the textbook statement), faithfulness entering only for Amitsur exactness in degrees <= 1, the unit N = (B tensor N)_0, and uniqueness of descent. Property descent along faithfully flat maps: finite presentation (new to the tree; mathlib only had the algebra form), finite projectivity, and INVERTIBILITY (via dual-commutes-with-base-change for finite projectives, retract argument) — so the descended module of an invertible module is invertible (Module.DescentDatum.invertible_descended, the lane deliverable). Confirmed absent from mathlib v4.31: any Amitsur complex, any effective descent of modules. Unit-cocycle recipe for the Picard consumers documented (toSpanSingleton coaction from a unit of B tensor B; cocycle condition = coassoc). Descent/{ModuleDescent,InvertibleModule}.lean, 635 lines, no scheme imports, mathlib-PR candidate; registered in the root, full build green (8585 jobs), axiom audits standard three

Naturality of the relative Picard functor in the curve: g : C' -> C induces Pic_{C/k} -> Pic_{C'/k} via right-whiskering pullback, natural in T by the monoidal exchange law, strictly functorial in g; axiom-clean

Presented étale covers of an affine base (Wave-3 lane L6, file 10): Algebra.EtaleCover A as a Type-u index of finite-variable polynomial presentations of étale A-algebras with surjective spectrum map — kernel-ideal realization of the design's presentation decision (OPEN-3 closed: the choice-based 'of' constructor + carrier equivs make directedness and base change instance-only, no relation bookkeeping). Carrier gets Etale + FaithfullyFlat instances (flat via Smooth.flat, faithful via of_comap_surjective); Refines preorder as mere existence per the choice discipline; common refinement Spec(B ⊗ B') with prodInl/prodInr witnesses and directedness; trivial cover refined by everything; base change A' ⊗ B along any A → A' with baseChangeInclude; field cofinality PROVED (every cover of Spec K is refined by a single finite separable field extension, via mathlib's étale-over-field product dictionary + single-factor projection) with ofField packaging. Pure algebra, no scheme imports, mathlib-PR candidate; registered in the root; kernel build green, axiom audits standard three

Divisor classes from local equations (Wave-3 lane L2, file 4, delegated build): Scheme.LocalEquations packages one regular section per member of a pointed cover with unit overlap-ratios — the trivialization data of O(D) with transition units g i j = f_i/f_j; stalk-level regularity is the primitive (restrictions to sub-opens stay nonzerodivisors via sheaf section_ext), making the ratio unit UNIQUE, whence the cocycle identity on triple overlaps and the Čech Picard class picClass. Invariance ledger: refinement (picClass_restrict), unitwise rescaling via an explicit v⁻¹-coboundary (picClass_rescale), and multiplicativity on the common refinement (picClass_mul, anchored on mk_mul_mk_inf). Pullback compatibility deferred (line cap).
